title: Remote Sonographer - Clinical Imaging Quality Analyst
description:
About Us
Hawthorne Health is a leading community site network and home research visit solution provider, with 20+ sites and more than 2,000 research experienced healthcare professionals across the U.S. Hawthorne leverages convenient, trusted, healthcare locations, identified patient data, and intelligent technology to accelerate patient access, improve retention, and reduce study costs. By embedding high-quality research within local communities, Hawthorne makes clinical trials more accessible and convenient for patients. Our community-based model shortens timelines and helps bring better treatments to market, faster.
About the Role
This role will perform data management activities for clinical research projects in accordance with Good Clinical Practices and all applicable procedures, guidelines, laws and regulations. The Clinical Imaging Quality and Data Compliance Analyst role is an integral role designed to provide project support to the clinical operations team. This role directly reports into the Clinical Research Manager(s) and with oversight from the Director of Clinical Research Operations.
What You'll Be Doing | The Role

Post-Visit Data Management:

• Ensuring the data from visits is uploaded to the Hawthorne platform within a specific timeline.

• Reviewing project data within a specific timeline and delivering data in a timely manner to key stakeholders.

• Communicate to in house Cardiology and sonography teams on timelines expectations.

• Requesting and managing source/data corrections as needed.

• Uploading/entering data to third-party platforms (e.g., uploading echo images).

• Reviewing and resolving data queries.

• Participate in database lock activities.

• Perform a regular review (quality check) of data.

• Reviewing data for completeness and data quality/integrity (ALCOA+).

• Escalate or mitigate data issues according to Hawthorne standards.

• Ability to work with multiple different software programs.

• Assisting in the identification of potential adverse events.

• Notifying the appropriate stakeholders of potential adverse events in accordance with safety reporting timelines.

• Maintain project documents and project TMF

• Train, mentor, coach other sonographers

What You Bring | The Person

• Dual registered: cardiac and vascular required

• Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences-related field preferred.

• 2-4 years of sonography experience.

• 1-2 years of clinical trial and data management experience.

• Knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP).

• Strong skills in the use of technology, tools, operating systems, and software.

• Strong organizational skills with experience balancing priorities and resources.

• Strong attention to detail is a must.

• A creative and resourceful problem-solver with strong critical thinking skills.

• An expert at planning, anticipating challenges and opportunities, and proactively taking steps to either avoid issues or operationalize new ideas.

• Able to work thoughtfully and decisively, anticipating the need to involve others, to foster an inclusive work environment that avoids unnecessary “fire drills” or “chaos.”

• Experience with electronic data capture (EDC) systems, including Oracle Clinical and/or Medidata Rave, preferred.

• Experience training sonographers, preferred

That’s when the HVLS Fan Company was born-with the first-ever patented high-volume, low-speed fan. But that name? BOR-ing. And customers knew it. title: Principal Enterprise Data Platform Architect
description:
About the role
As the Principal Enterprise Data Platform Architect, you will serve as the technical lead and pillar head for Data Platform Engineering within the Data Excellence & AI Foundations organization. Reporting directly to the Director of Data Excellence & AI Foundations, you will be responsible for defining, architecting, and evolving Avery Dennison ’s enterprise 10-Layer Data & AI Operating System. In this role, you will lead the technical transition from legacy ETL pipelines toward a modern, high-code Platform Engineering practice grounded in GitOps, Data-as-Code, declarative management, and automated metadata control planes while mentoring and elevating internal engineering talent.
Key Responsibilities
Position Location: Remote

• Own the global architecture blueprint and technology decision trees for Avery Dennison 's enterprise analytical and AI platforms, architecting the 10-Layer Modern Data Operating System across multi-cloud environments (OCI, GCP, Azure).

• Architect and deploy the centralized Metadata Control Plane and automated Data Catalog, coordinating schema tracking, lineage graphs, data quality observability, GitOps methodologies, reusable developer toolboxes, and context-as-code for LLM reasoning.

• Design and govern enterprise AI infrastructure standards, including Vector Databases, Knowledge Graphs, Feature Stores, and RAG pipelines for corporate Gemini LLM solutions and autonomous AI agents with deterministic verification mechanisms.

• Design and enforce the Universal Security Model incorporating Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), fine-grained masking, and Okta/Active Directory identity integration, while implementing SRE-style observability for platform health, latency, query performance, and compute costs.

• Serve as Pillar Lead for the Data Platform Engineering squad, guiding and mentoring technical talent across pipeline, data, analytics, AI/LLM, DevOps, and APEX engineering while partnering with HR on technical career progression tracks and competency matrices.

Qualifications

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field with 10+ years in enterprise data architecture, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure design (including 3+ years leading technical teams in a global enterprise context).

• Expert technical proficiency in multi-cloud environments (OCI, GCP, Azure), Oracle ADW (23c/26ai), Databricks, and Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake table formats.

• High-code data engineering mastery in Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, Kafka/Confluent streaming, Change Data Capture (CDC / GoldenGate), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitOps CI/CD deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI).

• Direct experience architecting enterprise AI/ML infrastructure, including Vector DBs, Knowledge Graphs, Feature Stores, RAG pipelines, and enterprise LLM integrations (Gemini).

• Strong strategic leadership and communication skills with a proven track record of mentoring technical talent, establishing Universal Security Models (ABAC, RLS, Okta/AD), and presenting complex architectural blueprints to executive sponsors (VP/CIO).

Pay Transparency
The salary range for this position is $141,825 - $211,792 / year.
The hiring base salary range above represents what Avery Dennison reasonably expects to pay for this position as of the date of this posting. Actual salaries will vary within the range, and in some circumstances may be above or below the range, based on various factors including but not limited to a candidate’s relevant skills, experience, education and training, and location, as well as the job scope and complexity, responsibilities, and regular and/or necessary travel required for the position, which may change depending on the candidate pool. Avery Dennison reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

title: Quels sont les grands accélérateurs permettant de donner une place plus importan
description:
Description du poste
La business unit Digital Customer accompagne les grandes entreprises des secteurs Retail, Luxe, Biens de consommation, Services dans l’accélération de leurs stratégies digitales. Au sein de la BU DC, l'offre Digital Makers (50 Designers, 100 Product Owners/Managers, 50 développeurs et 100 Data Analysts/Scientists au sein de l'offre) accompagne les entreprises dans la réalisation de leurs projets digitaux. Cet accompagnement de bout en bout se base sur plusieurs axes d'action parmi lesquels :

• l'identification précise des problématiques et enjeux à adresser à travers le déroulement rigoureux d'une démarche centrée utilisateurs itérative afin de booster l'adoption

• l'amélioration de l'efficacité et de la scalabilité des méthodes à travers l'automatisation, l'industrialisation, et l'IA

• la passation fluide entre les équipes de conception et les équipes de réalisation permettant d'accélérer la production et d'en améliorer la qualité

L’UX est l’expérience utilisateur, l’émotion, l’intuition et la connexion que l’utilisateur.rice ressent quand il utilise un site ou un produit. La conception de cette expérience utilisateur devient un élément différenciant dans des marchés de plus en plus compétitifs. On parle aujourd’hui d’UX 360° car l’expérience utilisateur est confrontée à des enjeux complexes liés à la diversité des canaux (omnicanalité, parcours phygitaux...), à l'attente d’expériences hyper-personnalisées par les utilisateurs, à la nécessité d'assurer l'accessibilité des produits et leur éco-conception, et à la protection des données, tout en tirant parti des dernières avancées technologiques pour offrir une expérience utilisateur exceptionnelle et en constante évolution.
Dans ce contexte, Wavestone accompagne les Grands Comptes pour les aider à améliorer l'expérience utilisateur de leurs applications tout en favorisant l'industrialisation de l’UX Design au sein de leur DSI.
Objectifs du stage
L’objectif de ce stage sera de développer des connaissances, des convictions et un savoir-faire de premier plan sur un des nombreux sujets que recouvre l’UX Design. Les résultats devront apporter à Wavestone des atouts différenciateurs sur le marché.
Parmi les thématiques prioritaires de la practice, le ou la stagiaire pourra explorer l’impact de l’intelligence artificielle sur les métiers de l’UX. Ces technologies transforment en profondeur la conception, l’évaluation et l’évolution des services numériques, en ouvrant de nouvelles opportunités pour comprendre les utilisateurs, personnaliser les expériences et optimiser les processus de conception. Dans ce contexte, le stage pourra s’articuler autour de plusieurs axes :

• UX et expérience client augmentées par l’IA : analyser l’impact de l’IA sur les comportements utilisateurs, identifier les nouveaux standards d’expérience et définir des recommandations adaptées aux enjeux de nos clients.

• IA et Data au service des designers : explorer les outils et méthodes exploitant l’IA et les données pour accélérer la recherche utilisateur, l’idéation, la conception et l’évaluation des expériences.

• Industrialisation de l’UX grâce à l’IA : étudier comment l’IA, les Design Systems et l’automatisation permettent de concevoir des expériences plus cohérentes, efficaces et scalables.

Le stage mêlera veille, recherche, expérimentation et contribution à des cas d’usage concrets afin d’accompagner les équipes et les clients dans l’adoption de ces nouveaux leviers.
Travaux à réaliser
Le ou la stagiaire viendra faire grandir l’offre interne de Wavestone sur le futur de l’UX et l’UX Design. Sous la supervision d’un.e tuteur.rice de stage, et en s’appuyant sur les éléments de capitalisation déjà en place, le ou la stagiaire aura pour responsabilité de :

• Conduire des entretiens / animer des ateliers avec des consultants de Wavestone pour recueillir leurs retours d’expérience et s’appuyer sur l’expertise cabinet ;

• Recenser les bonnes pratiques du marché actuel et les tendan

title: Vice President, Analytics
description:
At Spectrum Science , our mission-connecting humankind to its best healthlife-comes to life through a culture rooted in curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. We believe breakthrough ideas happen when diverse perspectives are embraced and people are empowered to challenge what’s possible.
Join our team of award-winning health-focused experts across advertising, clinical trial experience, communications, consulting, media, medical communications, and patient engagement. Together, we create the momentum that moves science, brands, and careers forward.
About the Role
The Vice President, Analytics will lead communications measurement and insight development across earned, social, digital, influencer, corporate reputation, patient advocacy, and stakeholder engagement programs. This role partners with strategy, creative, media, and client service teams to translate data into recommendations that shape strategy, demonstrate impact, and strengthen client relationships.
As a senior leader, this person will advance how Spectrum defines, measures, and communicates engagement opportunities and program performance. The ideal candidate is a consultative partner and people leader who can turn complex data into compelling stories for executive audiences while developing a high-performing analytics team.
Job Responsibilities

• Lead measurement strategy for integrated communications programs across earned, social, digital, influencer, reputation, disease awareness, advocacy, and stakeholder engagement initiatives.

• Partner with account, strategy, media, social, creative, and client leads to define KPIs, reporting approaches, and measurement plans aligned to business objectives.

• Translate performance data, audience insights, media intelligence, social listening, and competitive analysis into clear recommendations and executive-ready presentations.

• Oversee analytics workstreams from data collection and analysis through dashboard/report development, quality control, and client delivery.

• Develop measurement frameworks, benchmarks, scorecards, and reporting standards that connect communications activity to outcomes.

• Use media and social listening to identify conversation trends, audience behaviors, white space opportunities, reputational considerations, and emerging issues.

• Support new business and organic growth by shaping analytics approaches, drafting measurement scopes, estimating resourcing, and contributing to proposals and statements of work.

• Manage, mentor, and develop analytics team members across measurement strategy, insight storytelling, data visualization, and client partnership.

• Stay current on analytics tools, methodologies, platform changes, AI-enabled measurement approaches, and privacy considerations.

Desired Skills and Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, data analytics, statistics, social sciences, public health, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.

• 8+ years of analytics, research, insights, measurement, or communications strategy experience within an agency, healthcare communications, public relations, corporate communications, or related environment.

• Strong understanding of earned media analysis, social listening, digital performance, influencer analytics, audience research, reputation tracking, and integrated campaign reporting.

• Ability to connect data to communications strategy, client business goals, message optimization, audience engagement, and program effectiveness.

• Experience developing dashboards, scorecards, measurement frameworks, reporting templates, and client presentations.

• Proficiency with tools such as Brandwatch, Meltwater, Cision, Talkwalker, Sprinklr, Google Analytics, social platform analytics, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skil

title: Supervisor, Child Safety Operations
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

SpaceXSI’s Safety team protects free expression while ensuring our users can safely and successfully engage with our platform through robust policy enforcement. Child Safety is our highest-stakes area: the team identifies, investigates, and removes child sexual exploitation (CSE) and child sexual abuse material (CSAM) across X and Grok products, including AI-generated content, and makes the legally required reports to NCMEC. As we increasingly leverage AI-based automation, we innovate and experiment at a fast pace, striving to be a learning organization with a growth mindset.

As Supervisor, Child Safety, you will lead the Austin-based Child Safety analyst team across shifts. You will be hands-on with escalations, own the quality and defensibility of every high-risk decision, and coordinate with Safety leadership, Legal, and law enforcement response teams on high-profile cases. You will lead the team’s shift from scaled manual review to analysts focused on “Automation First” appeals, model evaluations and audits, investigations, and escalations. 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead the Austin based Child Safety team, a team of analysts (including senior analysts) covering X and Grok, with consistent standards across morning and night shifts and strict adherence to SLAs.

• Act as the escalation layer for Child Safety: be hands-on with complex, urgent, and high-profile cases, including high profile accounts, internal escalations from law enforcement response and legal teams, and SpacexSI products incident escalations.

• Own NCMEC reporting decisions for the team. Ensure every report, suspension, and bounce is accurate, well-documented, and meets legal obligations, and that the team knows when to escalate to Legal.

• Bring thoughtful, well-reasoned recommendations to leadership on escalations, balancing the protection of minors with SpaceXSI’s free speech principles (e.g., distinguishing CSE from adult content, humor and satire, or newsworthy reporting).

• Coordinate with Safety leadership, Legal, Engineering, and Policy on high-profile cases and action items with Head of Safety visibility. Communicate business needs clearly, close the loop on every action item, and do the due diligence before decisions go up.

• Run the team’s response to viral incidents and emerging abuse trends (e.g., leaked content of minors, AI-altered imagery, election-period trends): organize sweeps, track results, and escalate patterns quickly.

• Take an automation-first approach. Partner with Program Leads to calibrate classifiers and Grok enforcement, track false positives and repeated suspension/unsuspension patterns, and turn findings into concrete improvements.

• Lead the team’s operational model evaluations, audits, and labeling work for CSE, ensuring high-quality curated data that improves Grok’s ability to detect and act on child safety violations.

• Use querying languages (e.g., SQL or Python) and LLM-powered agents to analyze operational data, identify trends, and drive data-informed improvements to policies and processes. Build that habit across the team.

• Own your dashboards and KPIs: know hour to hour how the backlog and escalation

title: City Launcher, Groningen
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.

 

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/ and company https://www.monumental.co/about/. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel https://www.youtube.com/@buildmonumental, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns.

About the role

Over the last few years, Monumental has gone from developing a product that works and delivering our first pilots to building at scale - a fleet of 150+ robots that have laid bricks for 90+ homes, a school, a community centre, a hotel, and 150+ m of canal walls.

We're taking on more construction projects - "deployments" - every month, with more robots, more people, and now in new markets as we scale from the Netherlands into the UK and US.

As Hub Lead, you’ll stand up our first hub outside HQ, in the north of the Netherlands. You’ll start by running our largest deployment to date, then build the team and operations around it as the project pipeline ramps up behind you.

We're hiring versatile operators who want to run a deployment as if it were their own business. Behind every one of these projects is a Deployment Manager who owns it end to end. In practice this is five jobs in one: site foreman, operations manager, account executive, analyst, and project manager. You make the build plan, deploy yourself with your team on site as a subcontractor, manage the contractor relationship, and take responsibility for delivering quality walls, finished on time - in construction, one of the most chaotic industries there is. Your goal will be to run multiple deployments in parallel, overseeing complex and high stakes projects.

One day you're up at dawn, travelling to site, cutting bricks, running the schedule, working with the general contractor and watching your build plan go up brick by brick. The next you'll be at our facility analysing your deployment's P&L and building the systems that improve your margin on the next deployment. You’ll own delivery and translating friction you observe on-site to our R&D team.

This is hard, on-site operations, and some of the most rewarding work you'll find. Robots break, weather turns, the contractor changes the plan, and it's on you to keep the build moving.
You'll have an extraordinary amount of autonomy. It's an excellent fit if you've founded a company before, or if you're looking for an entrepreneurial role where you can make outsized impact.

What you’ll do

- Plan the logistics of a deployment: decide how many and which robots and humans to send, coordinate with other subcontractors, and make both a day-to-day operational plan while also thinking about the bigger picture and how your decisions impact our unit economics.

- Spend time on the construction site, overseeing, managing, and motivating the team; liaising with the general contractor

About the Team

OpenAI's Global Network Infrastructure team is responsible for building and operating the global network backbone that connects our rapidly expanding compute infrastructure. Our work enables reliable, high-performance connectivity across data centers, cloud service providers, and network points of presence (PoPs), supporting the infrastructure behind OpenAI's research and products.

As OpenAI continues to scale its compute footprint globally, we are expanding our network infrastructure to meet increasing demands for capacity, reliability, and operational efficiency. Our team works across physical network design, carrier connectivity, network deployment, and operational troubleshooting to deliver resilient infrastructure at exceptional scale.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Network Infrastructure Engineer to help design, deploy, activate, and operate OpenAI's global wide area network (WAN) infrastructure.

In this role, you will take direct ownership of bringing new network connectivity online, working closely with fiber providers, cloud service providers, and internal infrastructure teams to establish reliable connectivity across our global backbone.

You will be involved in everything from physical network design and circuit provisioning to troubleshooting complex connectivity issues across Layer 1, Layer 2, and Layer 3. You will play a critical role in expanding our network footprint, bringing new PoPs online, and ensuring that our infrastructure operates reliably as OpenAI continues to grow.

We're looking for engineers who enjoy working close to the infrastructure, thrive on solving difficult networking problems, and bring an automation-first mindset to scaling network operations.

- Own the end-to-end activation and turn-up of network circuits, working directly with fiber carriers and cloud service providers to establish and validate connectivity.

- Troubleshoot complex network issues across physical, Layer 2, and Layer 3 infrastructure, including optical signal problems, FEC errors, routing issues, and connectivity failures.

- Diagnose and isolate network failures across carrier, cloud provider, and internal infrastructure boundaries, driving issues through resolution.

- Contribute to physical network infrastructure design, including port mappings, fiber and cable layouts, optical distribution frames (ODFs), and connectivity planning.

- Monitor network health, circuit utilization, and performance to proactively identify capacity constraints and reliability risks.

- Build automation and tooling to streamline network provisioning, deployment validation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows.

- Collaborate with network engineering, data center infrastructure, and external service providers to support the expansion of OpenAI's global backbone.

- Participate in an on-call rotation to maintain the reliability and availability of critical network infrastructure.

- Have hands-on experience deploying, activating, and troubleshooting WAN circuits with telecommunications carriers, fiber providers, or cloud service providers.

- Have a strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including optical networking, Ethernet, TCP/IP, BGP, and Layer 2/3 connectivity.

- Are comfortable debugging network issues across multiple layers, from physical fiber connectivity and optical errors to routing and traffic forwarding.

- Have experience working with data center networking, carrier infrastructure, cloud interconnects, or large-scale WAN environments.

- Understand physical network infrastructure concepts such as fiber cabling, port mappings, optical distribution frames, and network equipment connectivity.

title: CRM Solutions Lead
description:
Our product runs on our clients' data, and that data lives in their CRM. This role owns it end to end.
You'll work directly with clients to understand what's in their CRM - Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zoho or whatever else they run on - diagnose the data quality problems, define how it maps into our warehouse, and turn it into segments our campaign teams can act on. Once a client is live, you own the ongoing execution: loads, extracts, dedupes and segment builds.
Internally, you'll work closely with our data engineering and data science teams, giving them the inputs they need to build and run ingestion from each client CRM into our warehouse.
This role needs both kinds of strength. You need the technical depth to profile CRM data at scale and safely load it into a production instance, and the client-facing judgment to turn what you find into recommendations a client will act on.
Responsibilities
• Run discovery sessions with a client's sales, marketing and technical teams to understand how their CRM is actually used, and serve as our technical lead in the client relationship
• Document CRM structure: object models, custom objects and fields, picklists, record types, relationships, automations and integrations
• Profile CRM records across standard and custom objects for completeness, duplication, staleness, formatting inconsistency, invalid values and broken relationships, and quantify what you find
• Recommend how to address what you find, and take those recommendations to the client: what they need to fix at source, what we can resolve on our side, and what to exclude
• Translate available data into segments that are both technically buildable and commercially meaningful, in partnership with our campaign teams
• Build source-to-target field mappings into our data warehouse, specifying transformation logic, data types, picklist normalization, null handling, identity resolution keys and sync cadence
• Partner with data engineering and data science on the ingestion build, supplying the field definitions, business logic, sample data and validation rules they need, and stay engaged through build, testing and reconciliation
• Load records into client CRMs and extract them back out at volume, using native tools, data loaders and REST/Bulk APIs, owning staging, dry runs, dedupe rules and rollback plans

• 5+ years in RevOps, marketing ops, GTM engineering, solutions consulting, sales engineering or CRM consulting, with real operational ownership
• Direct experience owning client relationships and leading client-facing engagements
• Ability to run a discovery session with a skeptical stakeholder and leave with better information than you came in with
• Comfortable presenting evaluation findings and recommendations to client stakeholders, including when those findings are critical of their existing data or processes
• At leasts 3 years of deep, hands-on experience with at least two major CRMs (Salesforce and HubSpot preferred): object models, admin configuration, import/export tooling, REST and Bulk APIs
• Proven bulk data operations at volume: loads, upserts, merges, dedupes and write-backs into production systems, with the judgment to do them safely
• Data quality experience: profiling, deduplication, standardization, enrichment, identity resolution
• SQL proficiency and strong spreadsheet skills
• Experience producing source-to-target mapping documentation for an engineering audience
• Clear written communication
Preferred requirements
• Working knowledge of GoHighLevel, Zoho, Dynamics, Pipedrive or Close
• Python or similar for profiling, transformation scripts and API-driven bulk operations

• Experience in commercial real estate or real estate: CRM, data or operations work in the industry

title: Product Manager, LangSmith
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The LangSmith team owns and builds LangChain's core platform for observability, evaluation, and production reliability of AI systems. From tracing and annotation to run rules, evaluations, and beyond, this team owns LangSmith end-to-end. If you want to define what great AI observability looks like at production scale, this is where that work gets done.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Manager to own key parts of LangSmith. Building AI products is changing the way software teams work; LangSmith is the observability, evals and deployment platform that makes shipping reliable AI systems possible.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

This role sits at the intersection of user experience and production infrastructure. You'll partner with engineers to build features that feel intuitive while solving deeply technical problems: versioning complex prompt chains, debugging multi-step agent failures, or designing evaluation systems that scale from 10 to 10,000 test cases.

You'll work directly with customers - from early-stage startups shipping their first agent to enterprises running mission-critical AI systems - to understand where the platform breaks down and what capabilities unlock new workflows.

- Own the roadmap for a core area of the LangSmith platform.

- Work with customers to understand their challenges and define new product features.

- Work with engineering to define scope, make technical tradeoffs, and ship high-impact features quickly.

- Help shape product strategy alongside our founders and leadership team.

- 3+ years of product management or engineering experience, ideally building developer tools, infrastructure products, or technical SaaS platforms.

- Deeply technical - you can hold your own in conversations about API design, system architecture, data pipelines, and debugging production issues.

- Bias toward action - you'd rather ship, learn, and iterate than build the perfect solution upfront.

- Strong written and verbal communicator who can align cross-functional teams around a shared vision.

NICE TO HAVE

- Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent technical background.

- Previous experience at a high-growth startup or developer-focused company.

- Hands-on experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI applications.

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

title: Analyste Business et Fonctionnel Senior (Freelance possible)
description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités
Le cadre du projet
Le projet s'inscrit dans une administration fédérale belge chargée de l'établissement et de la perception des impôts, droits et taxes, ainsi que de la gestion des informations et services associés pour les citoyens, les entreprises et les professionnels.
Dans ce cadre, une vaste base de connaissances juridique et réglementaire multilingue est entièrement reconstruite sur la base d'une architecture de données gouvernée. La plateforme s'adresse aux collaborateurs internes et à un large public externe de professionnels, notamment des comptables, des fiscalistes et des juristes. Le développement est organisé par phases, avec une gouvernance des données au centre de l'architecture et des jalons de décision clairement définis.
Le rôle
En tant qu'Analyste Business / Fonctionnel senior, vous rejoignez une équipe restreinte de profils seniors qui établit les fondations de la plateforme avant l'augmentation de la capacité de développement. Vous assurez la liaison entre le métier et l'IT, recueillez les besoins, modélisez l'information et rédigez les spécifications qui orientent un développement assisté par IA, toujours soumis à une revue humaine. La mission se déroule par étapes, selon des jalons de décision clairement établis.
Principales responsabilités

• Préparer et animer des ateliers avec les gestionnaires de contenu, les experts métier et les key users internes et externes.

• Documenter les processus actuels de rédaction, de traduction, de validation, de publication et de dépublication.

• Dresser l'inventaire fonctionnel de l'application existante, notamment pour la recherche, la taxonomie, les abonnements et les profils utilisateurs.

• Recueillir, analyser et prioriser les exigences selon la méthode MoSCoW, puis constituer, gérer et affiner le product backlog.

• Définir les personas et les parcours utilisateurs des collaborateurs internes, des professionnels externes, des citoyens, des partenaires API et des outils d'IA.

• Définir le modèle de classification des documents, avec les niveaux public, interne, restreint et embargo, puis formaliser les règles de publication avec le métier.

• Rédiger des spécifications d'intention destinées à un pipeline de développement assisté par IA, avec des critères d'acceptation précis.

• Effectuer la validation fonctionnelle des incréments et coordonner les tests d'acceptation utilisateurs (UAT).

• Faire le lien entre le métier et l'IT, tout en analysant directement les données au moyen de SQL afin d'étayer les hypothèses.

📝 Votre profil

• Expérience significative en tant qu'Analyste Business / Fonctionnel dans des environnements IT et data complexes.

• Maîtrise de l'ingénierie des exigences et de la rédaction de spécifications assorties de critères d'acceptation, par exemple selon Volère / Robertson, les cas d'utilisation ou Gherkin.

• Bonne pratique des méthodes Agile, notamment des epics, user stories, story maps et de la gestion de backlog.

• Maîtrise de la modélisation des processus et de l'information, notamment BPMN, UML et les modèles conceptuels ou d'information.

• Solides bases en SQL, avec une affinité pour l'analyse et la visualisation des données au moyen de Power BI et Python.

• Une expérience en modélisation de données et/ou en gouvernance des données (Data Governance) constitue un atout majeur.

• La connaissance des API, notamment Open API, ainsi que des patterns d'intégration event-driven et pub/sub est un plus.

• La familiarité avec les notations d'architecture d'entreprise Archimate et TOGAF est un plus.

• Vous maîtrisez le néerlandais à un niveau natif ou équivalent et disposez d'une bonne connaissance du français et de l'anglais.

• Vous combinez une vision d'ensemble avec une attention précise portée aux données et aux détails.

Compétences obligatoires

• Ingénierie des exigences et rédaction de spécifications avec critères d'acceptation, notamment Volère / Robertson.

• Analyse Business / Fonctionnelle.

title: Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) & Co-founder - AI for Small Law Firms
description:
The Opportunity
AI is changing the economics of legal practice. Work that once took hours can increasingly be done in minutes, creating both enormous leverage for lawyers and new pressure to win and serve more clients efficiently.
Yet solo practitioners and small law firms still operate with many of the same constraints: missed calls, slow follow-up, intake handled between client matters, inconsistent marketing, and administrative work competing with billable time. Building larger intake, administrative, and marketing teams is expensive and increasingly unnecessary.
BloomLex is building a different model: a managed AI workforce that helps small law firms grow without growing their team.
The customer thesis has been validated through live pilots, and multiple deployments are moving into production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, repeatability, and scalability. The companies that successfully deploy trusted AI workers into professional-service verticals over the next 18 months have an opportunity to define entirely new categories. We intend to be one of them.
The Venture
BloomLex is building an AI workforce for solo practitioners and small law firms, helping them win and serve more clients without adding headcount.
We call the broader shift the Rise of the Solo: AI gives an individual lawyer or small firm access to capabilities that historically required a much larger organization.
Unlike self-serve software, BloomLex is fully managed. We configure, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve the AI workforce for each firm. Our customers evaluate us on outcomes - calls answered, prospective clients captured, consultations booked, demand generated, follow-up completed, and time saved - not on how much software they configure themselves.
Our AI workforce starts with two teammates:
Ava - AI Front Desk. Ava answers calls 24/7, handles structured intake, screens and routes inquiries, books consultations, performs outbound callbacks and follow-up, and integrates those interactions into the firm's workflow.
Claire - AI Marketing Assistant. Claire helps firms generate and nurture demand through content, digital marketing, campaign management and optimization, lead nurturing, and ongoing marketing execution.
Together, Ava and Claire address both sides of growth: Claire helps create demand; Ava helps ensure that demand is captured and converted.
They are also the beginning, not the end, of the platform. Our roadmap expands the AI workforce across the operational side of the practice - including custom workflows and additional specialized AI roles - all delivered through the same managed model and coordinated around the lawyer.
The Partnership
The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, live pilots are running, and the technology and deployment infrastructure are being built for scale.
What remains is to complete the founding team with a commercial co-founder - someone who will own revenue and go-to-market with the same conviction, urgency, and sense of ownership as the CEO and CTO.
This is not a role where you inherit a sales team, a mature playbook, and a predictable funnel. You will help discover and build those things.
You will personally close early customers, determine which channels scale, refine the commercial model from real market evidence, and then build the organization capable of repeating it.
This is a co-founder and leadership role, not simply a sales hire. You will join the CEO and CTO as one of three co-founders, with founder-level equity, founder-level responsibility, and a meaningful voice in go-to-market, pricing, hiring, fundraising, product direction, and company strategy.
What you'll own
As Co-Founder & CRO, you will own the commercial journey from first conversation through acquisition, retention, and expansion.

title: Robotics/Hardware Engineer, Simulation Engineer
description: Lumen Labs | Robotics/Hardware Engineer, Simulation Engineer | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE | Full-time | $150k-200k + equity | https://lumenresearch.co Howdy! Lumen Labs is building the cognitive layer for physical AI. Nearly every major robotics effort today teaches machines by showing them thousands of hours of human teleoperation. We think that paradigm has a ceiling, and we’re working on nature-inspired architectures for unstructured environments (construction sites, mining, pipelines, battlefield). Pre-seed, backed by top VC funds and operators from robotics/AI companies. Today we run wheeled navigation, we’re dipping our toes into drones, and we’re eyeing weirder platforms like home inspection. We’re a small team hiring two engineers who will work closely with each other and with our model engineer: ROBOTICS / HARDWARE ENGINEER: Own the hardware and infrastructure that keeps our research platforms running: the ROS2 (Humble) stack across onboard and offboard compute, sensor integration and calibration (LiDAR, depth, IMU, encoders), the safety pipeline during autonomous runs, and getting trained policies onto real hardware. Will be hands-on with real mobile robots (UART, encoders, PWM, IMU, LiDAR), strong Python + embedded, comfortable reading code you didn’t write, and can debug hardware and firmware at the same time. Full posting: https://desert-bearskin-26d.notion.site/Robotics-Engineer-Ro... SIMULATION ENGINEER: Own “the gauntlet,” our test library for putting new architectures through their paces: a Gymnasium-style interface on both sides (environment and model) so anything built to spec is compatible with everything else. Mostly MuJoCo and Gazebo today, moving toward Isaac Sim, and some other more bespoke sims. You will be building task simulators for training and testing and keeping them running (GPS-denied drone nav, construction sites, boat cleaning, forklifts, abstract control), including physics, honest sensor models, digital twins of our real platforms, domain randomization, and the sim compute. Dungeon Master. If you have built or substantially rebuilt a simulator of some kind (robotics/RL is closest, but a physics-based game, scientific sim, or flight sim mod counts) this would be a good role for you. Comfortable with the Gymnasium/dm_control way of thinking, can pick up GPU-vectorized sim (MJX, Isaac Lab, JAX) quickly, and test-driven. Full posting: https://desert-bearskin-26d.notion.site/Simulation-Engineer-... Email hi@lumenresearch.co, mention HN and which role, and tell us about a project you’ve built. If you can link to a trained policy running on real hardware (robotics) or a simulator you built or fixed and something you trained inside it (sim), you go to the top of the pile.

Reporting to the Head of Editorial, your mission is to identify, recruit, and nurture authentic partnerships with ambassadors who can deliver reach, credibility, trust, and relatability for our brand-while building an aspirational brand that women genuinely want to engage with.

You aren't here to chase follower counts or manage transactional influencer deals. Your role is to build a strategic ambassador ecosystem that creates genuine connections with our audience and produces high-performing content that works both organically and in paid media. Every ambassador you bring on should elevate our brand, making women think, "I want to be part of what they're part of."

At Juniper, we believe authenticity drives performance. Your success is defined by your ability to find the right voices, build meaningful relationships, and create a content engine that scales our message while maintaining the trust and empathy our category demands.

We'll also expect you to:

Create processes that allow us to manage multiple ambassadors simultaneously without losing quality.

Ensure content feels native to each platform-Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, podcasts-while maintaining Juniper's brand integrity and aspirational positioning.

Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Order domain (Nasa team) at Vinted. 

Our team focuses on Order fulfillment, enhancing the happy path along logistics workflows and integrations to deliver smooth and reliable order processing and an exceptional customer experience. 

Our team builds and owns the end-to-end order fulfillment experience, ensuring every order is seamlessly prepared, shipped, tracked, and delivered with clarity, reliability, and scale

You’ll work alongside mobile, web, and backend engineers in a cross-functional, autonomous team, delivering features that directly impact over 80 million users. As a backend engineer, you’ll write business logic, develop APIs, and help scale our platform to support rapid growth. Join us to work on large-scale projects and help make second-hand the first choice!

Take a look at engineering.vinted.com to see what we’re up to.

In this position, you’ll 

• Work in a team and shape features that make our members’ lives better

• Work with Golang, Ruby on Rails, MySQL, Memcached, Elasticsearch and many more technologies. You don’t need prior experience with all of them.

• Craft the code which can handle more than 2M requests per minute and 12-15 transactions per second

• Apply Agile and Lean principles in your work, participating in planning, retrospectives, and other ceremonies.

• Collaborate with other developers through GitHub pull requests and code reviews

• Work in a fully data-driven environment - all code changes are A/B tested, giving you clear, measurable feedback on how your work affects users, performance, and business outcomes.

• Take part in architecture and backend decision-making, shaping technical solutions and standards that have a long-term impact on the Order domain and Vinted’s platform.

• See your code impact 80 million users almost instantly-our master branch is rolled out to production multiple times per day

• Break down large monoliths into smaller, manageable components and services

• Own your service end-to-end: from system architecture and design to deployment, observability, and performance tuning. Monitor system performance using tools like Grafana, and Kibana

• Own SLIs/SLOs in the product team

• Write unit tests (RSpec) for all of the code you write. We have >10000 tests that run in ~5 minutes through our Jenkins setup

• Effectively partner across teams to prioritize and deliver results

• Participate in on-call rotations to ensure our product performs well

title: Sr People Business Partner — AI-Powered People Strategy, Global BP Team & Corporate Functions
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

Most HR teams are talking about AI. At Zscaler, we're building with it - and we want someone who'll help lead that build, not just adopt it.

As Senior People Business Partner , you'll sit inside our People Business Partner Leadership team with a mandate few PBP roles offer: co-design how our entire global PBP function operates, then put your own designs into practice with the leaders you support across Finance, Legal, Biz Dev, and People & Culture. This isn't a "use the new tool we bought" role - you'll help decide which agentic workflows, automations, and data products the function builds next, pilot them yourself, and scale what works across 30+ global PBPs supporting 9000 executives, managers and employees globally. This is a hybrid role, based out of our Santa Clara, CA HQ. 

If you're the person on your current team who's already experimenting with AI before anyone asks you to, who gets more energized by "how do we 10x this" than "how do we maintain this," this is built for you.

How You’ll Make an Impact (Role Expectations)

• Architect Scalable Solutions: you'll design and pilot our first agentic workflow for performance across the organization, ensuring People Business Partners and managers are taking actionable steps to drive intended talent outcomes.

• Design and roll out other AI-augmented practices and global frameworks, such as Organizational Health scorecards and People Plans that empower People Business Partners enterprise-wide to spend less time on administration and more time driving strategic impact.

• Empower & Coach Leaders: Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leaders and people managers, enabling data-led coaching on performance management, career progression frameworks, and high-performing team dynamics.

• Drive Strategic People Programs: Lead end-to-end execution for key People & Culture initiatives-including bi-annual performance and compensation planning cycles, engagement surveys, and talent reviews-tailored for global impact.

• Turn Workforce Data into Action: Analyze key workforce metrics (attrition, hiring trends, mobility, team engagement) to uncover actionable insights and proactively solve organizational challenges before they arise.

• Champion Culture & Resolution: Partner with People Relations and business leaders as a trusted, neutral advocate to resolve complex employee relations matters with empathy, fairness, and absolute discretion.

• Optimize the Employee Journey: Pinpoint friction points across employee lifecycles and streamline operational workflows, elevating the overall employee and manager experience.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels you

title: Lead Insurance Product Manager - Part D/PDP
description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is seeking a Medicare Part D expert to join the team as a Lead Insurance Product Manager who is ready to shape PDP strategy, guide complex decisions and turn regulatory requirements into executable products. As Lead Insurance Product Manager for PDP Strategy & Execution, you’ll serve as the product lead for Humana ’s standalone Prescription Drug Plan portfolio. You’ll connect Medicare Part D strategy to accurate, compliant and timely execution across the full product lifecycle, from early market and regulatory assessment through bid development, filing, implementation and annual readiness.

You’ll bring together Product, Pharmacy, Actuarial, Finance, Regulatory Compliance, Legal, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Digital, member communications and program delivery partners to make complex decisions, resolve competing priorities and translate approved strategy into a clear execution path. You’ll assess member, regulatory, financial and operational tradeoffs and provide recommendations that help leaders make informed decisions. This role is designed for an advanced individual contributor who operates with significant independence, leads through expertise and influence, and raises the standard for PDP product management. You’ll guide other associates and work groups, establish methods and priorities for complex initiatives, strengthen governance and reusable tools, and build shared capability so critical knowledge and accountability extend beyond one subject matter expert.

Key Role Functions

Shape PDP Portfolio Strategy and Direction

• Lead year-round PDP product strategy and execution, translating enterprise priorities, customer needs, market dynamics, regulatory requirements and financial considerations into actionable portfolio recommendations

• Integrate competitive, financial, regulatory, operational and member insights to evaluate product opportunities, risks and tradeoffs

• Analyze competitor participation, premiums, deductibles, cost sharing, formulary positioning and emerging market trends to identify implications for Humana ’s PDP portfolio

• Develop recommendations for new or enhanced benefits, product features and market approaches, including the business rationale, member impact, operational dependencies, risks and implementation path

• Look beyond the immediate bid cycle to anticipate future portfolio needs, policy changes and market shifts and position partners for effective execution

• Represent PDP Product Management in strategy and leadership forums, communicating the recommendation, supporting insights, tradeoffs and decisions needed

Lead PDP Bid, Benchmark and Filing Execution

• Lead product strategy and readiness across the annual PDP bid cycle, including benefit design coordination, bid submission readiness, PBP Section Rx and HPMS activities, validation resolution and alignment across key functions

• Coordinate benchmark, de minimis, rebate reallocation, desk review and related PDP activities, ensuring impacts, options, decisions and accountable owners are clear

• Lead review and resolution of filing questions, validation findings, audit exhibits and other CMS submission issues, escalating material product risks at the appropriate time

• Establish working plans, governance, decision points and controls that support accurate, timely and compliant submissions

• Maintain clear records of assumptions, decisions, dependencies, risks, status and ownership throughout the bid cycle

• Provide final product-level review and sign-off for designated PDP submissions and deliverables consistent with established governance

Translate Regulatory Change and Lead Feasibility

• Interpret CMS guidance and Medicare Part D policy changes and translate them into clear product implications, requirements, decisions and downstream impacts

• Lead feasibility assessments across product, regulatory, actuarial, financial, pharmacy, operational, technology and member-experience c

title: Enterprise Account Manager (Public Sector)
description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Public Sector Account Executive, Singapore

Delinea is hiring a Public Sector Account Executive to own and grow our business across the entire Singapore market. This is a quota-carrying, individual-contributor role for an experienced cybersecurity sales professional who thrives on building relationships at the senior executive level and closing complex, public sector-scale deals.

As the identity security control plane organizations trust to govern access across human, machine, and AI identities, Delinea helps enterprises reduce risk and strengthen governance. In this role, you will represent that mission directly to the Singapore’s government agencies, government link company and statutory board partnering with senior and C-level stakeholders to shape how they secure privileged access.

What You’ll Do

As our Public Sector Account Executive for Singapore, you will:

- Own and grow the full Singapore public sector market as the primary Account Executive, driving new business and account expansion.

- Build and cultivate relationships with senior and C-level executives across target Public Sector accounts.

- Develop and execute territory and account plans to consistently meet and exceed sales quotas.

- Lead the full sales cycle for Delinea’s identity security and privileged access management solutions - from prospecting through negotiation and close.

- Partner closely with sales engineering, channel, and marketing teams to build and progress pipeline.

- Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline reporting in CRM.

We’re looking for a proven, senior-level seller who brings:

- Ability to independently cover and grow the entire Singapore market as a single-threaded territory owner.

- Established senior executive relationships and a strong professional network across the Singapore public sector market.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Frontend)
description:
Footprint is the agentic platform that learns your compliance program and runs it end to end.

Compliance teams at banks and fintechs are drowning in financial crimes investigations. Transaction volumes are surging, regulators keep raising the bar, and the work still runs on manual review queues stitched together from legacy vendors. Percy, our agentic system, learns each team's procedures and makes the same calls their analysts would: clearing false positives, escalating real risk, writing the case narrative, and documenting every decision for audit. It cuts review workloads by 70%+.

The harder problem is underneath. Every investigation is grounded in the data sources compliance teams already trust, and every case commits to an organizational memory that compounds - so a pattern one analyst caught in March surfaces automatically in October, across KYC, EDD, sanctions, and monitoring. Whether the team is five analysts or 500, they share one brain. Every memory carries provenance. Agents propose; humans approve. That's four years of identity infrastructure sitting under the agent, and it's the part nobody can bolt on later.

We're backed by QED, Index, and Box Group, and trusted by FDIC- and OCC-regulated banks plus fintechs like Bilt, Nuvei, and MoonPay. We 5x'd revenue last year. The team is small, senior, and ships fast.

THE ROLE

For four years, Footprint's frontend was the front door for developers: onboarding flows customers embed, SDKs they integrate, a dashboard where they configure verification.

Percy changed who lives in the product. Over the past year, compliance teams and investigators moved from configuring Footprint to working inside it: reviewing what an agent found, editing the case narrative, signing off on decisions a regulator will read. The interface became the place our users do their job, and the bar for polish, speed, and clarity rose with it.

The team that owns all of this is a small team of senior engineers. The design system, the SDKs, the monorepo tooling, the release pipeline - all of it runs through them, and they set the standards the rest of engineering ships frontend against.

You'll report directly to Head of Frontend Engineering - Rafael Motta.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- User-facing features, end to end. From spec to build to deploy to iterate, making the product and design tradeoffs along the way. The analyst-facing surfaces are the newest part of the product and the least settled

- The SDKs external developers use to embed Footprint. Clean APIs and good docs here shape our customers' integration experience directly, and those decisions are hard to take back once someone has shipped against them

- Platform and tooling. CI/CD, releases, and our pnpm monorepo. This work has been carried alongside product work, which is why it's on this list

- Performance and observability. You own the performance budgets and the monitoring for screens people sit in all day

- The design system. Own and evolve the component library, keeping the UI consistent, accessible, and fast to build on

- Customer empathy. Talk to the people who use what you build and turn what they struggle with into the product

STACK

React · TypeScript · Next.js · Tailwind · Vercel

Deep experience with most of this, and the judgment to pick up the rest, is what matters.

MUST-HAVE

- 4+ years shipping production frontend in modern React and TypeScript - fluent in both, and comfortable moving fast in a large shared codebase

- You ship end to end, prioritize outcomes, and make smart tradeoffs between speed, polish, and scope

- Genuine design sense - you sweat the details, and the interfaces you ship show it

- You write readable, well-structured code and can lead technical decisions without over-engineering

- You've owned the lifecycle of what you ship: the release, the performance budget, and the alert that fires when it regresses

- You use AI to move faster and raise quality, and you read every line you ship

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-FIRST BY DEFAULT

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

- Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

- Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.
